title: Kimetsu no Yaiba Addon| Mugen Castle Dimension Fix
description: Fixes structure generation inside the Mugen Castle Dimension and protects the player from falling into the void
body:
This is a simple lightweight datapack that fixes structure generation separation inside the Mugen Castle Dimension preventing structures from overlapping aggressively with each other, which makes it really difficult to explore and fight inside the Mugen Castle.
It also prevents the player from falling into the void by teleporting him back to ~ 100 ~ once he reachs y=-20 so he won't go deeper inside the void to the point where he starts to take damage.
Please, be aware that this datapack doesn't ELIMINATE structure overlapping completely, however, it reduces it to the point where it won't be hard to explore or fight inside the Mugen Castle.

Supported Mod:
- [Kimetsu no Yaiba (Demon Slayer)](https://modrinth.com/mod/orca-kimetsu-no-yaiba)

### **Features:**
- Reduces structure overlapping inside the Mugen Castle by increasing structure separation
- Protects the player from falling into the void
